go2cs: testing.AllocsPerRun counted 10 go2cs-runtime object allocations (2,800 bytes) over 10 run(s) — the figure reported above is an allocation COUNT per run, from go2cs's own runtime counter (golib's allocation sites), which is the structural mirror of Go's runtime.MemStats.Mallocs. The CLR publishes no in-process malloc counter (see the measured survey on testing.AllocsPerRun). The count covers golib's sites only: allocations the C# compiler emits in converted code (closures, params arrays, interface boxing) and BCL internals are outside it, so this is a LOWER BOUND on the true object count.
